svg.title: Channel vs equalizer
svg.desc: The TinyTapeout analog pin path and what the CTLE has to do about it
svg.text: The channel is the chip's own pin — and the equalizer has to invert it
sky130, tt / 27 °C / 1.8 V. Frequency response, differential.
The pin path alone costs 13.7 dB
at Nyquist and shuts the eye at the
pad. The CTLE as first drawn had no
peaking at all (§C2), so it could not
to within half a dB, and to ±2 dB
